dataset_name: Retinal Fundus Multi-Disease Image Dataset (RFMiD v1.0)
source_publication: Pachade et al. (2021), 'Retinal Fundus Multi-Disease Image Dataset (RFMiD) for Screening of Ophthalmic Diseases', Data, 6(2), 14. doi:10.3390/data6020014

multi_label_structure.evaluation_mandate: Strict One-vs-Rest Binary Classification per condition. Mutually exclusive softmax is mathematically invalid.

mapped_internal_conditions.supporting_source: Pachade et al. (Data, MDPI 2021), Table 3 & Verified Label CSVs
mapped_internal_conditions.clinical_distinction_notes: Direct correspondence to non-proliferative and proliferative diabetic retinal vascular changes.
mapped_internal_conditions.metric_eligibility: One-vs-Rest Binary AUROC, Specificity, Sensitivity, Precision-Recall AUC

mapped_internal_conditions.supporting_source: Pachade et al. (Data, MDPI 2021), Table 3 & Section 2.2
mapped_internal_conditions.clinical_distinction_notes: Ground truth Disease_Risk == 0 indicates absence of any detectable retinal lesions/risk.
mapped_internal_conditions.metric_eligibility: Specificity, Normal-vs-Abnormal Discrimination, Negative Predictive Value

mapped_internal_conditions.statistical_power_category: Borderline / Limited (Small N: 20 <= N_pos < 50; Wide CIs)
mapped_internal_conditions.supporting_source: Pachade et al. (Data, MDPI 2021), Table 3 & Verified Label CSVs
mapped_internal_conditions.clinical_distinction_notes: RFMiD v1 defines MS as Macular Scars (27 total cases; Train: 15, Val: 5, Test: 7). Direct correspondence to internal Macular Scar class. Wide bootstrap CIs required.
mapped_internal_conditions.metric_eligibility: One-vs-Rest Binary AUROC, Specificity, Sensitivity (Pre-specified wide bootstrap CIs due to N_pos=27)

mapped_internal_conditions.supporting_source: Pachade et al. (Data, MDPI 2021), Table 3 & Verified Label CSVs
mapped_internal_conditions.clinical_distinction_notes: Central Serous Retinopathy / Chorioretinopathy. Direct correspondence to localized neurosensory macular detachment (61 cases total; Train: 37, Val: 11, Test: 13).
mapped_internal_conditions.metric_eligibility: One-vs-Rest Binary AUROC, Specificity, Sensitivity, PR-AUC

mapped_internal_conditions.supporting_source: Pachade et al. (Data, MDPI 2021), Table 3 & Verified Label CSVs
mapped_internal_conditions.clinical_distinction_notes: Optic Disc Edema (blurred disc margins, neuro-ophthalmic disc swelling). Distinct from Drusen (DN). Total 96 positive cases (Train: 58, Val: 21, Test: 17).

mapped_internal_conditions.statistical_power_category: Severely Inadequate (N_pos=10 < 20; Statistically Fragile / Exploratory Only)
mapped_internal_conditions.supporting_source: Pachade et al. (Data, MDPI 2021), Table 3 & Verified Label CSVs
mapped_internal_conditions.clinical_distinction_notes: Direct correspondence to hereditary pigmentary retinopathy presenting with peripheral bone-spicules. CRITICAL LIMITATION: Severely inadequate sample size (N=10 across full 3200 cohort; Train: 6, Val: 2, Test: 2); point estimates are statistically fragile.
mapped_internal_conditions.metric_eligibility: Exploratory Descriptive Analysis Only; Ineligible for standalone statistical validation claims

mapped_internal_conditions.supporting_source: Pachade et al. (Data, MDPI 2021), Table 3 & Verified Label CSVs
mapped_internal_conditions.clinical_distinction_notes: RFMiD v1 annotates Myopic Atrophy (MYA; 167 cases total; Train: 101, Val: 34, Test: 32). Internal source class includes broader high/pathological myopia fundus changes. Feature-level morphological evaluation only.
mapped_internal_conditions.metric_eligibility: One-vs-Rest Binary AUROC (Conditional on MYA feature alignment), Specificity

mapped_internal_conditions.supporting_source: Pachade et al. (Data, MDPI 2021), Table 3 & Verified Label CSVs
mapped_internal_conditions.clinical_distinction_notes: RFMiD v1 annotates Optic Disc Cupping (ODC; 445 cases; Train: 282, Val: 72, Test: 91), which is an anatomic sign, NOT a clinical diagnosis of Glaucoma. Physiological cupping without glaucoma exists, as does normal-tension glaucoma without severe cupping. Ineligible for definitive glaucoma clinical sensitivity/F1.
mapped_internal_conditions.metric_eligibility: Ranking Agreement, AUROC vs ODC; Ineligible for definitive clinical diagnostic specificity/F1

mapped_internal_conditions.supporting_source: Pachade et al. (Data, MDPI 2021), Table 3 & Verified Label CSVs
mapped_internal_conditions.clinical_distinction_notes: CRITICAL PROTOCOL REQUIREMENT: Published Table 3 and verified CSVs confirm RT is Retinal Traction Detachment (25 positive cases total; Train: 14, Val: 6, Test: 5); no general/rhegmatogenous RD label exists in RFMiD v1. Tractional detachment is etiologically and morphologically distinct from primary rhegmatogenous or serous detachment. Direct external evaluation of Retinal Detachment is marked UNAVAILABLE. RT is eligible only for secondary exploratory analysis with explicit disclaimers.
mapped_internal_conditions.metric_eligibility: Direct External Evaluation UNAVAILABLE; Exploratory RT AUROC Only

bootstrap_ci_prespecification.method: Percentile Bootstrap (Stratified by Binary Ground Truth)
secondary_metrics: Balanced Accuracy (at pre-registered internal operating point)
bootstrap_ci_prespecification.statistical_power_disclaimer: Sample counts reported directly. Support alone does not imply adequate statistical power; wide confidence intervals will be explicitly displayed for low-support classes (MS N=27, RT N=25, RP N=10).
